entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello, David. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I need to return a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you provide me with your order number?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Shell Helmet. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's really just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I thought it would be from the pictures online. I haven't even taken it out; the box is still unopened.
I understand. And you're right to be particular, especially when it comes to safety equipment. You want to make sure you have the right gear. Let me just check our return policy for you.
Okay, I see here that you received the item 59 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window, so I can definitely approve a full refund for you.
That's great. So what's the next step?
I'm generating a prepaid return label for you now. I'll send it to the email address we have on file. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method.

Excellent. Now, since I'm going through the trouble of sending this back and I do plan to order a different helmet from you, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Maybe 15% for being a loyal customer?

I appreciate you asking and we certainly value your business. However, our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on preference-based returns. I can assure you the full refund for this helmet will be processed promptly, so you'll have that credit back to put towards your new one.
Alright, that's fair. I had to ask. So the label is on its way to my email?
That's correct. It should be in your inbox within the next 5-10 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that covers it. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
